description: Check a document for hidden text before your agent reads it. PDF, Office, RTF, HTML.
name: ai.hiddencontent/mcp

environmentVariables.description: API token for the HiddenContent service. Get one at https://hiddencontent.ai/start — the server refuses to start without it and says so.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the service. Defaults to the hosted API; set it only when pointing at a self-hosted instance.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of what your agent can actually do. The only accepted values are `tool-use`, `network-egress` and `code-execution`. These turn on the checks for concealed text that instructs a model to call a tool, send data or run code — declaring more can raise severity and never lowers it, and declaring nothing leaves those checks inert. Defaults to `tool-use` in the bundle install.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_CAPABILITIES

title: HiddenContent
